user.title: TV Italia
user.description: Choose the Italian free-to-air channels to show. The guide is downloaded from a public XMLTV source.

set_favorite.name: Set favorite channel
set_favorite.description: Adds or removes one or more channels from favorites. If 'Favorite' is omitted, it toggles.

favorite.name: Favorite
favorite.description: Turn on or off. If omitted, toggles.

stasera.name: Tonight on TV
stasera.description: Returns tonight's prime-time programmes (21:30), with a message ready for a notification.

only_favorites.name: Favorites only
only_favorites.description: Only include favorite channels (all channels if no favorites are set).

guide_unavailable.title: The TV guide is not updating
